_note: Which S3 error codes read as a refused key (EACCES), for both hosts' is_denied / isDenied. code is the error's Code (python) and name (typescript). A HEAD's 403 is bodiless: botocore spells it as the code "403", the JS SDK names it Unknown and keeps 403 in $metadata, which typescript's own tests cover. A credential failure with a body keeps its own code; behind a bodiless HEAD it reads as a refusal.
